note: Transmog Stone drops (DF-TRANSMOG-DROPS-1147). Every number here can be changed; the backend reads this file at start. chance is 0 to 1 (0.35 = 35%).
killNote: A behemoth killed on a hunting ground or patrol (the game's PlayerLoot grant with one kill).
missionEndNote: The end of an escalation (its last behemoth), a trial, or another mission such as a pursuit or story mission (the game's End of Mission grant). The hunt type comes from the player's own island hunt.
heroicNote: When the hunt id contains this word (for example CR19_PlayerHunt_Escalation_Randall_Heroic), a drop gives this many stones instead.
